items.name: Engkarse
keyTests: One slender upright main flowering stem, not several competing thick branches
Four pale rose-lilac petals and six stamens
Rounded pinnate basal leaflets, narrower upper stem leaflets
Short terminal flowering raceme and slender siliques

items.name: Ballblom
keyTests: Solitary globose lemon-yellow head per unbranched flowering stem, with overlapping petaloid sepals
Sepals roughly 10-15, not a few enormous inflated petals
Deeply divided palmate basal leaves, toothed sublobes
Realistic proportions and natural single or few-flowered habit

items.name: Engsoleie
keyTests: Upright, distinctly branching flowering stems, not exclusively basal stalks
Deeply palmately divided and toothed leaves; sparse narrower upper leaves
Correct bud, floral center and leaf placement
